scripts.preview:env: bash -c '(cd apps/merchant && npm run preview:env) & (cd apps/client && npm run preview:env -- "$@") && wait' --
scripts.mcp:auto:openrouter: AI_MODEL='' AI_API_KEY='' AI_API_URL='' npx tsx apps/mcp/src/knowledge/generate.ts --max-token-override=99000 --auto-refresh --no-model-fallback --provider=openrouter && cd apps/mcp && npm run gen-knowledge
scripts.mcp:auto:mistral: AI_MODEL='' AI_API_KEY='' AI_API_URL='' npx tsx apps/mcp/src/knowledge/generate.ts --max-token-override=99000 --auto-refresh --no-model-fallback --provider=mistral && cd apps/mcp && npm run gen-knowledge
scripts.mcp:auto:flash: AI_MODEL='' AI_API_KEY='' AI_API_URL='' tsx apps/mcp/src/knowledge/generate.ts --auto-refresh --max-token-override=30000 --no-model-fallback --provider=gemini && cd apps/mcp && npm run gen-knowledge
scripts.ai:encrypt: bash -c 'source .env && if [ -n "${CRYPTOKEN}" ]; then openssl enc -aes-256-cbc -a -pbkdf2 -iter 100000 -salt -in ai.json -out ai.json.enc -pass pass:"${CRYPTOKEN}" && echo "✓ ai.json.enc written"; else echo "Skipping ai:encrypt because CRYPTOKEN is not defined or empty"; fi'
scripts.ai:decrypt: bash -c 'source .env && if [ -n "${CRYPTOKEN}" ]; then openssl enc -d -aes-256-cbc -a -pbkdf2 -iter 100000 -in ai.json.enc -out ai.json -pass pass:"${CRYPTOKEN}" && echo "✓ ai.json written (keep it out of git!)"; else echo "Skipping ai:decrypt because CRYPTOKEN is not defined or empty"; fi'
scripts.ai:kv:push: bash -c 'source .env && NS_ID=$(jq -r ".kv_namespaces[0].id" apps/merchant/wrangler.jsonc) && wrangler kv key put --namespace-id=$NS_ID ai:config --path=ai.json.enc && echo "✓ ai.json.enc uploaded to KV_CACHE"'
scripts.ai:kv:push:remote: bash -c 'source .env && npx wrangler kv key put --remote --namespace-id=$KV_CACHE_ID ai:config --path=ai.json.enc'
